summary.en-US: Live Cursor usage, budget tracker & local security scanner in your browser.

description.en-US:
Cursor Curse Monitor by Lorapok shows your Cursor AI usage, budget cap, billing cycle reset, and spend-over-time trend — right in your browser toolbar.

  • Animated budget gauge with threshold warnings
  • Auto & API usage meters
  • Local security scanner on token paste — warns if extra secrets appear
  • Connect automatically via cursor.com/dashboard or paste a token manually
  • Tokens stay on your device — never sent to Lorapok servers

Also available on: Open VSX, VS Code Marketplace, GitHub Releases, Product website.

A product of Lorapok Labs. Built for Cursor users.

developer_comments.en-US: Auth: content script on cursor.com captures Bearer token from api2.cursor.sh requests only. Manual token paste fallback in Options. No Lorapok server receives tokens. Test: sign into cursor.com/dashboard, open popup, verify usage loads.
